jobs.occupation: Research Scientist
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on research scientist with deep expertise in medical imaging and strong technical skills in programming, data analytics and AI?

Do you enjoy combining scientific research with practical technical development, taking ownership and driving complex research collaborations towards successful outcomes?

Collective Minds is looking for a Research Scientist to drive scientific and technical contributions in public and private research consortia. This is an opportunity to combine research, technology and project ownership in a growing international healthtech company.

About Collective Minds
Collective Minds is based in Stockholm/Danderyd and we operate globally across clinical trials and life sciences. We are an imaging platform for clinical trials that connects hospitals, experts, and industry - including CROs, pharma, biotech, medtech, and eClinical vendors - enabling trials with imaging endpoints and the generation of high-quality evidence faster and more efficiently. We are a fast-moving, commercially minded team focused on collaboration, accountability, and impact. By combining deep domain expertise in medical imaging with novel cloud technology, we help customers reduce risk, ensure compliance, accelerate and scale research.

About the role
As Research Scientist, you will combine scientific expertise in medical imaging with hands-on technical development and ownership of selected research consortia.
Collective Minds currently participates in more than 10 public and private research consortia spanning medical imaging, big data, analytics and AI modeling and validation. These collaborations bring together academic hospitals, research organizations and industry partners across therapeutic areas such as oncology, immunology, cardiovascular and musculoskeletal research.

Acting as a data manager and platform provider, Collective Minds plays a central role in these collaborations. You will be responsible for our contributions in two to three consortia, with the opportunity to apply your scientific and technical expertise, work independently and contribute to impactful research.
Your main responsibilities:
Lead Collective Minds' contributions in selected research consortia, ensuring delivery within agreed budgets, timelines and scope.
Develop and implement technical solutions, including scripts, data pipelines, analytical tools, dashboards and AI-based applications.
Make scientific and technical decisions across medical imaging, data analytics, AI modeling and validation.
Ensure effective use of the Collective Minds platform, prioritizing standardized and scalable solutions over unnecessary custom development.
Manage project scope and stakeholder expectations, clearly defining deliverables and commitments.
Take ownership of work package delivery, reporting to consortium partners, coordinators and funders, and efficient project close-outs.
Collaborate with internal teams and external research partners, coordinating additional resources when needed.

Who are we looking for?
We are looking for a scientifically experienced and technically skilled professional who combines deep expertise in medical imaging with the ability to independently develop solutions and deliver complex research projects.
You are analytical, pragmatic and hands-on, with a proactive approach to problem-solving. You enjoy taking ownership, collaborating across disciplines and driving results in a fast-moving environment.

We believe you have:
A strong scientific background in life sciences, medicine, biomedical engineering or a related field, with deep expertise in medical imaging research.
Strong hands-on technical skills in Python, SQL, DICOM and AI frameworks, with experience developing scripts, data tools and analytical solutions. Familiarity with dashboarding tools such as Superset or Metabase is a plus.
Experience delivering work packages in research consortia or grant-funded projects, including grant execution, reporting and project close-outs.
A proven ability to independently manage research projects within agreed budgets, timelines and scope, and make informed scientific and technical decisions.
Experience coordinating work across academic, clinical and industry partners, with strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
Willingness to travel internationally as required, typically approximately every two months.
Ability to work regularly from our Stockholm/Danderyd office.

Why join Collective Minds?
At Collective Minds, you will join an innovative and ambitious company where technology, science and collaboration come together to make a meaningful difference in healthcare.
You will be part of an entrepreneurial environment with short decision-making processes, engaged colleagues and the opportunity to influence how things are done.
This is an opportunity to work with leading scientific and industry partners, contribute to innovative research collaborations and play an important role in the continued growth of an international healthtech company.

jobs.occupation: Embedded Software Architecture, SI ICE Control
jobs.description:
Embedded Software Architecture, SI ICE Control – Expert
Integro Consulting | Automotive & Powertrain Development | Sweden
Help shape the future of sustainable powertrain technology
Integro Consulting is seeking a highly experienced Senior Expert in Embedded Software Architecture and Spark-Ignited Internal Combustion Engine (SI ICE) Control for a consulting assignment with our client, Volvo Trucks.
This is an opportunity to contribute to next-generation powertrain technologies, particularly hydrogen-powered combustion engines and alternative fuels for heavy-duty applications.
Combining expertise in embedded software, model-based control, and engine management with technical leadership, you will help develop advanced control systems, automate engineering workflows, and explore the potential of physics-inspired AI and machine learning.
About the assignment
You will contribute to early-phase development and concept engineering within a multidisciplinary powertrain organisation. Your primary focus will be embedded software architecture and model-based control systems for spark-ignited engines, particularly hydrogen internal combustion engines (H2 ICE).
You will work across engineering disciplines to develop robust, scalable control solutions while improving software development, testing, verification, and calibration through automation. You will also investigate how physics-inspired AI/ML can enhance modelling, diagnostics, control strategies, and engineering optimisation.
Key responsibilities
Embedded software architecture: Define scalable architectures and control concepts for SI ICE applications, particularly hydrogen engines.

Engine control: Develop and integrate ECU functions for air-path management, torque modelling, combustion control, knock detection, and knock control.

Model-based development: Translate system requirements into control models, software implementations, and verified solutions.

Software integration: Integrate ECU functions with sensors, actuators, diagnostics, communication interfaces, and powertrain platforms.

Automation: Improve software development, code generation, continuous integration, testing, and verification workflows.

Calibration optimisation: Automate calibration processes, measurement-data analysis, test planning, and optimisation.

Physics-inspired AI/ML: Explore physics-based and data-driven methods for modelling, control, diagnostics, and optimisation.

Testing and verification: Support SIL/HIL testing, engine test-bench activities, calibration, and release-readiness assessments.

Technical leadership: Lead design reviews, coordinate engineering activities, provide technical recommendations, and share knowledge.

Required qualifications and experience
We are looking for a senior technical expert who can take ownership of complex engineering challenges and deliver high-quality solutions.
You should have:
An M.Sc., PhD, or equivalent expertise in control engineering, mechatronics, electronics, automation, applied physics, mechanical engineering, or a related field.

Typically 12+ years of relevant experience in powertrain development, embedded systems, or automotive product development.

Extensive experience in model-based control for spark-ignited combustion engines, including requirements, modelling, implementation, integration, verification, and calibration.

Deep knowledge of ECU function development, air-path control, torque modelling, combustion control, and knock detection and control.

Strong experience in embedded software architecture, AUTOSAR Classic, software integration, diagnostics, and automotive communication protocols.

Knowledge of functional safety and cybersecurity, including ISO 26262 and SAE J21434.

Experience with SIL/HIL testing, engine test benches, data analysis, and technical documentation.

Practical experience in automated software development, code generation, scripting, continuous integration, and automated testing.

Experience in ECU calibration and optimisation, including test planning and measurement-data processing.

Advanced working knowledge of MATLAB/Simulink and Python.

Experience with ATI Vision and/or AVL Concerto. Knowledge of ETAS INCA, ETAS ASCMO, TargetLink, and C/C++ is also relevant.

Strong technical leadership, analytical skills, and the ability to communicate complex topics clearly in English.

You are proactive, structured, and results-oriented, with the ability to challenge established approaches constructively and collaborate across engineering disciplines.
Meritorious experience
The following would be particularly valuable:
Development or calibration of hydrogen, natural gas, or other alternative-fuel SI engines, especially for heavy-duty applications.

Experience with physics-inspired AI/ML, physics-informed learning, hybrid modelling, virtual sensing, anomaly detection, or data-driven control.

Applying AI/ML to improve engineering workflows, software development, testing, or calibration.

Knowledge of software-defined vehicle architectures, AUTOSAR Adaptive, or RTOS-based solutions.

Experience in heavy-duty powertrain development, calibration, verification tools, or engineering methods.

Contributions to technical roadmaps, patents, scientific publications, or engineering competence development.

Interested in this opportunity?
If you have the expertise to advance embedded engine control and sustainable powertrain technology, we would like to hear from you.
Please submit your CV and a brief summary of your relevant experience, highlighting your expertise in embedded software architecture, SI ICE control, model-based development, ECU calibration, and automation.
Please also include your availability and any experience with hydrogen engines or physics-inspired AI/ML.
Apply through Integro Consulting to discuss the assignment and how you can contribute to this exciting development programme.

jobs.occupation: Process Assistant Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Process Assistant Engineer to join our Sweden factory and support the daily management, optimisation and continuous improvement of our separator coating processes.
About Senior Material Europe
At Senior Material Europe, we manufacture separator film – a thin film used in lithium-ion batteries, including batteries for electric vehicles. The separator is a key component that helps make lithium-ion batteries safer, more durable and more efficient, supporting the transition towards a more electrified future.
Our production is modern, advanced and operated under controlled cleanroom conditions. The manufacturing process consists of four main process steps, where precision, stability and quality are essential.
Together, we are building advanced manufacturing capabilities in Europe and developing solutions that make a difference – both today and for the future.
The Role
As a Process Assistant Engineer, you will support the daily operation and continuous improvement of our slurry, coating and slitting processes. You will work with production and process data, assist in troubleshooting and process validation, and contribute to improving process stability, product quality and production efficiency.
The role is hands-on and cross-functional, giving you the opportunity to work closely with Production, Quality, Equipment and R&D teams while developing your technical and analytical skills in a modern manufacturing environment.
Job Responsibilities
Assist in the daily maintenance and optimisation of separator coating processes, including slurry, coating and slitting parameters and other key process conditions.

Provide technical support to Production and assist in troubleshooting issues related to process parameters, materials and other process abnormalities.

Collect, organise and analyse production data and key process parameters, identify abnormal trends and support continuous process improvement.

Assist in process validation and DOE trials, evaluate the impact of parameters on process and product performance, and support optimisation of the process window.

Participate in internal and customer quality investigations using methods such as 5 Why, Fishbone Diagram and FTA.

Assist in developing PDCA actions and verifying their effectiveness.

Support new product trials, new slurry and raw material validation, and process condition verification.

Follow up on trial production and analyse relevant process and quality data.

Work with Equipment Engineers to analyse how different equipment functions affect product quality and support equipment and process improvements.

Assist in preparing and maintaining SOPs, process parameter sheets, work instructions, validation reports, technical reports and other process-related documentation.

Cooperate with Production, Quality, Equipment and R&D teams to resolve production issues, improve process stability and continuously improve product quality.

Your Background
We are looking for someone with:

A bachelor's degree in engineering, chemistry, materials science, manufacturing or another relevant field.

At least 1 year of relevant industrial or manufacturing experience.

A structured and analytical approach to problem-solving.

An interest in process development, production technology and continuous improvement.

Good communication and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively across different functions.

The ability to analyse data, identify trends and support fact-based technical decisions.

A hands-on approach and the ability to work in a production environment.

Good English communication skills, both spoken and written, in an international working environment.

It Would Be an Advantage If You Have
Experience from coating, slitting, slurry preparation or other continuous manufacturing processes.

Experience with process validation, DOE or statistical process analysis.

Experience with structured problem-solving methods such as 5 Why, Fishbone Diagram, FTA or PDCA.

Experience working with production, quality or process data.

Experience from the battery, automotive, chemical, materials or other advanced manufacturing industries.

Familiarity with technical documentation, SOPs and process specifications.

What You Can Expect
You will join an international industrial organisation where process engineering plays an important role in ensuring stable production, high product quality and continuous improvement.
The role offers hands-on experience with advanced manufacturing processes and the opportunity to work closely with Production, Quality, Equipment and R&D teams.
You will have the opportunity to develop your technical and analytical skills while contributing to the optimisation of processes that support the production of separator film for the next generation of lithium-ion batteries.
We value responsibility, collaboration, continuous learning and straightforward communication. Different perspectives are important to us, and we encourage an open and respectful working environment.

jobs.occupation: Finnish radiographers wanted for opportunity in Sweden
jobs.description:

Are you a qualified radiographer from Finland interested in taking the next step in your career in Sweden?
We are currently recruiting two Finnish radiographers for a smaller, well-functioning radiology department in a coastal community in central Sweden.

Canon CT
Samsung conventional X-ray
Ultrasound

CT
Conventional radiography
Planned and acute examinations

You will work closely with radiographers, radiologists, assistant nurses and other healthcare professionals.

Previous professional experience as a radiographer is an advantage, but not a requirement. Experience in CT and conventional radiography is particularly valuable.
Requirements
We are looking for candidates who:
Hold a radiographer qualification from Finland
Have the legal right to practise as a radiographer in Finland
Are currently working in an active clinical role as a radiographer
Are interested in working with CT and conventional radiography
Have good communication skills in English
Are motivated to learn Swedish
Are interested in establishing a long-term career and life in Sweden

Meritorious
Previous experience in CT
Previous experience in conventional radiography
Knowledge of Swedish
Swedish professional authorization

The location
The hospital is located in a smaller coastal community in central Sweden, with approximately 24,000 inhabitants in the local area.
The area offers a combination of small-town living and easy access to the sea, lakes, countryside and an extensive archipelago. It is particularly well suited to someone looking for a quieter lifestyle, short distances and good opportunities for outdoor activities and family life.
Schools and childcare are available locally, with good transport connections to larger cities.
Swedish language training and relocation
If you do not already speak Swedish at the required level, Swedish language training is provided and financed as part of the recruitment process.
You begin studying Swedish from Finland through individual online lessons with a private teacher while continuing your current work.

B2 to C1. During this period, work takes place in the mornings and Swedish studies in the afternoons, Monday to Friday.
Once you have reached the required Swedish level and obtained Swedish professional authorization, you begin working fully as a radiographer.
Salary
During the language completion phase in Sweden, while employed as a Radiography Assistant, 
the salary is: 30,800 SEK/month gross
After obtaining Swedish authorization and starting work as a Radiographer, the starting salary for a candidate without previous professional experience is: 31,100 SEK/month gross

Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during and after your relocation and employment

jobs.description:
Help Shape the Future of Sustainable Food

At Lantmännen Biorefineries, we develop sustainable ingredients from oats, wheat, and peas that help shape the future of food. As an Application Specialist, you will apply your expertise in ingredient functionality and food systems to develop food applications that demonstrate the full potential of our ingredient portfolio. You will be the technical expert connecting our ingredients with real-world food applications.

Your responsibilities include:

Developing and optimizing applications for existing and new food ingredients.
Designing and conducting trials to evaluate product functionality and performance.
Supporting customer projects through technical guidance, demonstrations, and troubleshooting.
Leading application-related projects from concept through prototyping and commercialization.
Evaluating analytical results and translating insights into product recommendations.
Identifying new opportunities through customer feedback, market insights, and emerging food trends.
Collaborating with Sales, Product Development, Production, and Quality teams to deliver successful solutions.
Ensuring compliance with food safety, quality, and regulatory requirements.

You have:

BSc or MSc in Food Science or Food Technology. We also welcome candidates with substantial hands-on experience in food application development, and deep expertise in ingredient functionality and food systems, especially within the field of dairy and meat analogues.
Experience in application development, product development, technical service, or food ingredient innovation.
Knowledge of food ingredients, functionality, and food processing.
R&D project management capabilities.
Knowledge of GMP, quality systems, and laboratory practices.
Excellent communication skills in English. Swedish is an advantage.

You are:

You combine a strong scientific mindset with practical food application expertise. Whether your expertise has been gained through formal education or hands-on experience, you understand the relationship between food ingredients, processing, structure, texture, and product performance. You can translate this knowledge into food products with the right texture, stability, and eating experience. You are systematic and analytical, while remaining practical and results-oriented in your approach. You use logical thinking and sound judgement to solve problems and drive projects forward efficiently. You are curious and open-minded, yet grounded and pragmatic You balance technical depth with practical execution, delivering results effectively without waiting for every detail to be fully understood

You share our values - Openness, Holistic view, Drive - and our promise of taking responsibility from Field to Fork.

What we offer you

At Lantmännen, sustainability, innovation, and long-term thinking are at the heart of everything we do. We offer an opportunity to work with industry-leading ingredients, contribute to the future of food, and grow within an international group that is continuously investing in innovation and people development.

That is how we make it matter, from field to fork.

Sounds interesting? 

We hope so! You can apply for the position online by attaching your CV or LinkedIn profile. To ensure a more objective and inclusive recruitment process, we ask you to answer a number of screening questions as part of your application instead of submitting a cover letter.

The recruitment process includes assessments and competency-based interviews. For the final candidate, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing will be conducted.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Lantmännen is an agricultural cooperative and Northern Europe’s leader in agriculture, bioenergy and food products. With grain at the heart of the operations, Lantmännen refine arable land resources to make farming thrive. Some of Lantmännen’s best-known food brands are AXA, Kungsörnen, Scan, GoGreen, FINN CRISP, Schulstad and Vaasan. The company is founded on the knowledge and values acquired through generations of farmers. By engaging in research, development and operations throughout the value chain, Lantmännen takes responsibility from field to fork.

Lantmännen Biorefineries is the only large scale producer and supplier of grain-based fuel ethanol in Sweden and is owned by Lantmännen. The company offers attractive, profitable and sustainable protein, ethanol and carbon dioxide products that are produced in a responsible way. The plants are located in Norrköping and Lidköping. Biorefineries has approximately 300 co-workers and an annual turnover of almost SEK 4,5 billion.

As Export Control Compliance Lead, you will establish and lead the Export Control Compliance Office, developing the governance, policies and processes needed to embed this programme across the Organization.

Working within the Resilience team in OSI-ICS, you will conduct classifications, screenings, due diligence reviews, compliance assessments and export-control evaluations. jobs.occupation: Network Engineer - Platform & Technical Enablement
jobs.description:
Join Telavox as a Network Engineer - Platform & Technical Enablement
Are you a network engineer with solid routing fundamentals who also feels at home in a Linux shell? At Telavox, our infrastructure team is growing, and we’re looking for a Network Engineer to help scale and secure the backbone of our global communication services.
More and more of our network runs on open source routing software on standard servers, managed as code, alongside traditional network gear. You’ll join a highly skilled, collaborative team that likes automation-first thinking and continuous learning. If you want hard problems with real impact and enjoy working across teams, this role is for you.
About the job
As a Network Engineer at Telavox, you’ll play a key role in designing, building, and operating our core network infrastructure. That covers data center networking, edge PoPs, cloud native integrations, and infrastructure automation. You’ll work with experienced engineers who share a DevOps mindset and work with autonomy, quality, and speed.
Your day-to-day work may include:

Designing and implementing scalable network solutions, both on-prem and across distributed global environments

Building and operating Linux-based routing alongside our existing network platforms

Automating configuration, monitoring, and provisioning with tools like Ansible, Python, and Bash

Expanding and maintaining our international edge network of PoP sites

Managing our hybrid infrastructure and private cloud, with Kubernetes networking at the core

Supporting our infrastructure APIs so product teams can self-serve

Ensuring high availability and performance with OSPF, BGP, EVPN, VXLAN and WireGuard/IPsec

Collaborating across product and platform teams to turn complex requirements into practical, robust infrastructure

This role can be based in either our Malmö HQ or in our Stockholm office.
About you
You’re a systems thinker with deep networking expertise and a drive to simplify, automate, and scale. You’ve run production networks at scale and know Linux well enough to troubleshoot and build on it, whether you already route on Linux or want to go further in that direction. You’re structured in your approach but flexible in how you find solutions.
Key skills and experience we’re looking for:

Extensive experience designing and operating production-grade network environments

Solid working knowledge of Linux and Linux networking

Strong command of routing protocols (BGP, OSPF), overlays (VXLAN, EVPN), and secure networking (WireGuard, IPsec)

Comfortable with automation and scripting (Ansible, Python, Bash)

Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as NetBox, Prometheus, and Grafana

Good understanding of network segmentation, zero trust principles, and security practices for critical infrastructure

Excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset; you enjoy sharing knowledge across team boundaries

Good to have:

Experience running routing or packet forwarding on Linux with open-source software

Experience with Juniper or similar carrier-grade platforms

Hands-on experience with hypervisor and container-based workloads, especially Kubernetes on-prem

Network or cloud certifications (JNCIE, CCNP, AWS, etc.)

 Join us at Telavox 💚
Since Telavox's journey started in 2002, we have strengthened our position as the leading forward-thinking communication platform for businesses. As a digital mobile operator, we develop and own our all-in-one communication platform, which integrates telephony, PBX, messaging, meetings, and contact centers, giving businesses a smarter way to connect.
Today, we’re a thriving company with 1.9 billion SEK in revenue and 500+ Telavoxers across nine countries. We embrace AI and automation to push the boundaries of business communication.
We offer flexible work options and adaptable hours, giving you the freedom to balance life and career while staying connected to our vibrant Telavox culture.
Read more about our new HQ in Malmö 🏠!
How to apply!
At Telavox, we don’t focus on fitting in. We focus on making room for everyone, regardless of background, experience, or who you are.
We’re always looking for great talent, and we review applications on an ongoing basis. If you’re excited about joining an innovative, AI-driven telecom company, we’d love to hear from you! Apply with your CV and cover letter in English.
Please note that, in accordance with GDPR, we only accept applications through our recruitment system, not by email.
For any questions, feel free to reach out to Hiring Manager Emil Nilsson at emil.nilsson@telavox.com

jobs.description:
RaySearch develops innovative software solutions to improve cancer care. Over 1200 clinics in more than 54 countries use RaySearch software to improve treatments and quality of life for patients. RaySearch was founded in 2000 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. The headquarters is located in Stockholm, with subsidiaries in the US, Europe, Asia and Australia & New Zealand. Today we are more than 485 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. We believe in equal opportunities, value diversity and work actively to prevent discrimination.
RaySearch is looking for a machine learning engineer with strong experience in medical image analysis to join our ML Imaging team in Stockholm. You will develop deep learning algorithms for medical image analysis in RayStation, our radiotherapy treatment planning system, helping clinical teams deliver effective cancer treatments. RayStation is used at more than 1,000 cancer clinics in more than 50 countries.
About the role
You will develop machine learning models for use in clinical practice, working on medical image segmentation, synthetic CT generation, image registration, and other medical imaging applications.
Working closely with internal clinical specialists and external partner clinics, you will translate clinical needs into methods and models and evaluate their performance. You will also collaborate with regulatory and quality experts to ensure that algorithms are developed, validated, and documented in accordance with applicable medical device requirements.
You will
Develop and evaluate deep learning algorithms for medical imaging using Python and PyTorch.
Prepare and curate clinical imaging datasets, configure and run model training, and maintain reproducible training workflows.
Review relevant research and assess the suitability of methods for clinical applications.
Design experiments and evaluate model performance using appropriate quantitative measures and clinical acceptance criteria.
Collaborate with clinical experts and external clinics on development and validation.
Contribute to the testing and documentation required for medical device software.

Your profile
You have strong experience in medical image analysis. You enjoy investigating problems, testing ideas, and turning promising methods into machine learning models. You take ownership of your work, can plan and carry out development independently, and know when to involve colleagues. You value collaboration, careful evaluation, and clear documentation, and are motivated by improving cancer care.
Requirements
A PhD or master’s degree in computer science, machine learning, engineering, mathematics, physics, or a related field.
At least four years of relevant experience in machine learning or medical image analysis, gained through research or industry, including doctoral research.
Extensive experience developing and evaluating deep learning models for medical image analysis.
A strong understanding of deep learning, computer vision, statistics, and applied mathematics.
Strong programming skills in Python and hands-on experience with PyTorch.
Familiarity with software engineering practices, including version control, testing, and code reviews.
Excellent spoken and written communication skills in English.

Meriting
Experience with 3D medical imaging, particularly CT, MR, or CBCT.
Experience with one or more of medical image segmentation, image registration, or image synthesis.
Experience developing and validating medical device software or other regulated software.
Experience with tools for experiment tracking, data versioning, and reproducible training workflows.

Our Culture  
At RaySearch, we share a passion for innovation and the fight against cancer. Our team consists of dedicated experts who strive to deliver exceptional results through collaboration, attention to detail, and cutting-edge technology. We take pride in our role as a leader in cancer treatment, developing solutions that truly make a difference for patients worldwide.  
Our Offer  
We offer a dynamic and inclusive work environment in Hagastaden, Stockholm’s Life Science Hub. Our modern office space includes an in-house gym, yoga classes, and social activities such as ping pong, table football, and after-work events. We also provide a fantastic lunch buffet, daily fika, and a stunning rooftop terrace with a 360-degree view of Stockholm. This comes with a competitive compensation and benefits package.
